core_loop: Explore the streamed glyph world, collect three sigils, unlock the Shattered Shrine, fight monsters and demons, and use the permanent Utopia return portal as the world home anchor.

verification.gpu_acceptance_required: Run normal Semantic ASCII mode on Windows/OpenGL and confirm portal glyph readability/beacon brightness.
verification.terrain_integration: Pass 23 preserves Pass 22 terrain-bound foundations/approaches and adds facade-center sealed thresholds derived from the same structure/destination authority.
verification.holoverse_native: Launch from HoloVerse Dimension Archive; verify same-window mount, TAB return, Utopia portal return, and host restoration.

known_limits: TinyDisplay verification bypasses the GLSL glyph post-process.
Container audio hardware may be unavailable; HoloVerse falls back to NullAudioManager during headless/native QA.

holoverse.native_return_portal: E at Utopia portal requests HoloVerse return without exiting the host
